steps.js: new Promise(r=>{const t=setInterval(()=>{const g=window.__ml.game.getState();const p=g.prompt;const s=g.state;if(p&&p.kind==='SELECT'&&p.mode==='priority'&&s&&s.step==='PRECOMBAT_MAIN'&&g.answeredPromptId!==p.id){clearInterval(t);g.action('PASS_PRIORITY_UNTIL_MY_NEXT_TURN');r('F9 in Main 1, nextStop='+p.nextStop)}else if(p&&p.kind==='ASK'&&g.answeredPromptId!==p.id){g.answer({bool:false})}},200);setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(t);r('Timeout Main 1')},90000)})

new Promise(r=>{const t=setInterval(()=>{const g=window.__ml.game.getState();const s=g.state;const p=g.prompt;const me=s&&s.players.find(x=>x.me);if(p&&g.answeredPromptId!==p.id&&p.kind==='PICK_TARGET'){const open=(p.targets||[]).filter(x=>!(p.chosen||[]).includes(x));if(open.length)g.answer({uuid:open[0]});else g.answer({bool:false})}if(me&&me.skips&&me.skips.length&&!me.active&&!p){clearInterval(t);r('skips='+me.skips+' Zug '+s.turn)}},300);setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(t);r('Timeout skips')},60000)})

new Promise(r=>{let clicked=null;const t=setInterval(()=>{const g=window.__ml.game.getState();const s=g.state;const p=g.prompt;const me=s&&s.players.find(x=>x.me);if(!me)return;if(p&&g.answeredPromptId!==p.id&&p.kind==='PICK_TARGET'){const open=(p.targets||[]).filter(x=>!(p.chosen||[]).includes(x));g.answer(open.length?{uuid:open[0]}:{bool:false});return}if(!clicked&&!me.skips&&p&&p.kind==='SELECT'&&p.mode==='priority'&&me.active){g.action('PASS_PRIORITY_UNTIL_MY_NEXT_TURN');return}if(!clicked&&me.skips&&!me.active&&!p){const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(e=>e.textContent.includes('Stopp')&&!e.textContent.includes('Passe'));if(b){b.click();clicked='Zug '+s.turn+' '+s.step}}else if(clicked&&!me.skips){clearInterval(t);r('Stopp in '+clicked+' -> abgebrochen in Zug '+s.turn+' '+s.step+(me.active?' (eigener Zug)':' (Gegnerzug)'))}},100);setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(t);r('Timeout, clicked='+clicked)},90000)})
